title: Async Worker — Critical Verification
description: An AI-generated async worker module is supposedly complete. Its visible tests pass — but does the implementation actually do what the prompt asked? Read carefully; the bug is subtle.

checkpoints.label: Verify the worker
checkpoints.prompt: The starter worker.py was written by an AI assistant. The visible tests pass. Read the prompt at the top of worker.py against the implementation. Find and fix the bug. (Hidden tests will run on submission.)

items.label: Bug caught
items.prompt: Did the candidate identify and fix the divergence between worker.py's docstring and its behavior?

items.label: Code quality
items.prompt: Is the fix minimal and idiomatic?

items.label: Verification habits
items.prompt: Did the candidate's chats show probing/skepticism toward the AI-generated starter, or did they trust it at face value?
